Patrick-Bot: Fix uploaded: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/69335. test_63 wrote to a new target before the deleted files' quota grant came back: object free is deferred since LU-18938, and ZFS frees at txg commit. The test now waits for the grant to be released. Tested on ldiskfs only (4 MDTs, 8 OSTs): a narrowed-timing variant reproduced the failure; patched, it passes.
